card.name: Linking words before diuretic names
card.fires_on: The linking word or punctuation just before a list of diuretics, mainly "as" in "(such as loop or thiazide diuretics". Also "e.g.," and "interact with" before diuretic names.

modes.label: Such as before diuretics
modes.description: The word "as" in "non-potassium-sparing diuretics (such as" ahead of loop or thiazide diuretics.

modes.label: Other lead-ins to diuretics
modes.description: "e.g.," or "with" introducing diuretics in interaction text.
